mapper.sql: id, pay_order_id, msg_type, msg_id, request_body, response_body, duration_ms, is_success, error_msg, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into pii_invoice_call_log (pay_order_id, msg_type, msg_id, request_body, response_body, duration_ms, is_success, error_msg, created_at) values (#{payOrderId}, #{msgType}, #{msgId}, #{requestBody}, #{responseBody}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select from pii_invoice_call_log where pay_order_id = #{payOrderId} and msg_type = #{msgType}
select from pii_invoice_call_log where pay_order_id = #{payOrderId} order by created_at desc
